title: Updates to GitHub Copilot billing and plans
Evaluation models in auto for individual plans
summary: GitHub Copilot offers access to evaluation models for individual non-enterprise users, and these models may be served in Copilot auto model selection.[^c-affa47e284]

title: GitHub Copilot app: The agent-native desktop experience
summary: At Microsoft Build 2026, GitHub introduced new tools, updates, and surfaces so agents can work the way you already work.[^c-b202022100] While the agentic shift has made development faster, it’s also led to disjointed workflows, more context switching, and too much time spent reviewing agent-generated code.[^c-a30546f6e5] If agents are going to be a durable part of how software gets built, they need a real place in the developer workflow.[^c-1c5d442cbe]

title: Gemini models in Copilot CLI, cloud agent, and the Copilot app
summary: Two Gemini models are now available across additional GitHub Copilot surfaces.[^c-5c32a32cd1]

title: Introducing Copilot CLI and agentic capabilities enhancements in JetBrains IDEs
summary: With Copilot CLI now available in GitHub Copilot for JetBrains IDEs, this update centers on new capabilities for Copilot CLI sessions, while also delivering a broader set of agentic improvements.[^c-111fbf7efd] For Copilot CLI sessions, that includes agent picker support, new slash commands, and the agent debug panel in public preview, along with the beginning of a phased transition to Copilot CLI agent as the default experience.[^c-7521662809]

title: GitHub Copilot in Eclipse: BYOK, skills, and chat updates
GitHub Copilot code review for Azure Repos is now in technical preview
summary: GitHub Copilot code review for Azure Repos is now available in technical preview, bringing on demand pull request reviews directly into your Azure DevOps workflow.[^c-4939283b68]

title: MAI-Code-1-Flash is now available for GitHub Copilot
Copilot CLI: Improved UI, rubber duck, prompt scheduling, and voice input
summary: GitHub Copilot CLI is getting a major refresh at Microsoft Build 2026.[^c-b92e7dc7da]

title: Extend GitHub with agent apps
summary: Agent apps are AI agents from GitHub partners, installable from the GitHub Marketplace, and integrated directly into GitHub.[^c-6c94a3ef63] You install an agent app just like any other GitHub App from the Marketplace.[^c-bb7f2d96c0]

title: Expanded technical preview availability for the GitHub Copilot app
summary: The GitHub Copilot app technical preview is now available to all existing Copilot Pro, Pro+, Business, and Enterprise customers.[^c-540a078ab9] Download the Copilot app for Windows, macOS, or Linux to get started.[^c-8f3731e7a5] Access for Copilot Free users and new subscribers will be opening soon.[^c-69a38e28bd]

title: Copilot Memory supports user preferences for Business, Enterprise
Schedule and automate tasks with Copilot cloud agent
summary: With the new automations feature, Copilot cloud agent can now run automatically, on a schedule or in response to repository events.[^c-7e3fbd6315] Automations let you hand off repetitive tasks to the agent without any manual input.[^c-3f4591e310]

title: Gain insights across your agent sessions with /chronicle
summary: Every Copilot session you run (e.g., fixing a bug, reviewing code, spinning up a feature) builds a history only you can query. /chronicle turns that history into standup summaries, personalized tips, and custom instructions that make Copilot work better for you over time.[^c-d34b32c639]

title: Shape Copilot code review around your team
summary: Copilot code review adapts to your team’s tools and standards and scales its depth to the complexity of each change.[^c-9d543120da]

title: Copilot SDK is now generally available
summary: The GitHub Copilot SDK is now generally available.[^c-86bc1ee9c9] You can embed GitHub Copilot’s agentic engine into your own applications, services, and developer tools with a stable API and production-ready support.[^c-b0aba406b3]

title: Cloud and local sandboxes for GitHub Copilot now in public preview
summary: GitHub Copilot can now run inside secure, isolated sandboxes, both locally on your machine and in the cloud.[^c-cf2a9386ec] Sandboxed Copilot experiences provide isolated environments for Copilot’s tool execution locally as well as fully isolated cloud sandboxes hosted by GitHub.[^c-38d09b3084]

title: What’s Coming Next in Visual Studio: Our Microsoft Build 2026 Announcements
summary: Microsoft Build kicks off today in San Francisco, June 2 and 3.[^c-d97ec70371]

title: GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio Code, May releases
summary: VS Code continues with weekly stable releases.[^c-899675f9eb]

title: Session sync and chronicle
summary: Your chat sessions now sync automatically to your GitHub account, giving you a personal, searchable history of your work across machines and workspaces.[^c-9e6cc09b3d] Each session captures the conversation, the files you touched, repository context (repo, branch, timestamps), and any pull requests, issues, or commits referenced along the way.[^c-a12f8dee86]

title: Retry network-dependent commands in the sandbox
summary: When a terminal command that is run by a _local_ agent requires access to domains that are not configured as allowed domains, the command is automatically retried inside the sandbox with unrestricted network access.[^c-49bb0ddb43] After that, if it still fails, it falls back to unsandboxed execution.[^c-7e58ac97ae]

title: Agents window (Preview)
summary: The Agents window is a dedicated companion window optimized for exploring, iterating on, and reviewing agent sessions across projects and machines.[^c-9217f12668]

title: Research agent (Preview)
summary: When you need to understand unfamiliar code, compare approaches, or learn how a library or API works, a quick chat answer isn't always enough.[^c-ca9c324616] The research agent runs deep research on a topic and produces a thorough, well-cited Markdown report by gathering and synthesizing information from your codebase, relevant GitHub repositories, and the web.[^c-3772f9705c]

title: Configure OAuth client credentials in mcp.json
summary: Some MCP servers expect you to authenticate with a specific, pre-registered OAuth client instead of relying on Dynamic Client Registration.[^c-7461e08426]

title: Enterprise-managed MCP authentication (Preview)
summary: If your organization centralizes sign-in at a single identity provider (like Entra, Okta, or Auth0), you probably don't want every MCP server running its own Dynamic Client Registration against its own authorization server.[^c-8622706dda]

title: Delayed extension auto-updates
summary: VS Code now applies a two-hour delay before automatically updating extensions to a newly published version.[^c-11dc40b722] When automatic updates are enabled, new versions are auto-updated two hours after they are published, adding an extra layer of protection against problematic or potentially compromised releases.[^c-bef4e44b56]

title: GitHub Universe is back: All together now, in the agentic era
summary: GitHub Universe is back: returning to the historic Fort Mason Center in San Francisco on October 28–29, 2026.[^c-393c0aa103] If you’ve been following all the AI agent conversations and wondering what’s useful versus what’s just noise, you’re not alone.[^c-8d22d3bbd7]

title: GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio — May update
summary: May 2026 brought sharper tooling for planning, reviewing, and managing your work with GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio 2026.[^c-d56fa5fe02]

title: Enterprise Teams is now generally available
summary: Enterprise Teams is now generally available on GitHub Enterprise Cloud.[^c-49516b219d]

title: Copilot Chat brings richer context to pull requests
summary: GitHub Copilot Chat now provides richer context and new capabilities when you’re working with diffs and pull requests on github.com.[^c-b8eaf37bd8]

title: Larger context windows and configurable reasoning levels for GitHub Copilot
summary: GitHub Copilot now supports larger context windows and configurable reasoning levels to help you tackle deeper, more complex work.[^c-2415658b82]

title: API access to billing usage reports now generally available
summary: The REST API for enterprise administrators to request and download billing usage reports in .csv format is now generally available.[^c-47e515d3db] With this new capability, the same billing reports that are available in the UI can now be programmatically created.[^c-d645034bf9]

title: Budget and usage management APIs now generally available
summary: GitHub’s expanded billing APIs to programmatically manage budgets, track usage, and access cost center data are now generally available.[^c-2d969efa0e]

title: Agent tasks REST API now available for Copilot Pro, Pro+, and Max
summary: Copilot Pro, Pro+, and Max users can now programmatically start and track Copilot cloud agent tasks with the Agent tasks REST API, available in public preview.[^c-9314902579] Copilot cloud agent works in the background in its own development environment, where it can make and validate code changes, then open a pull request.[^c-fc5bf7a9f4] The API makes it easy to weave Copilot cloud agent into custom automations.[^c-f8b4f84604]

title: Fix with Copilot for failing Actions now in Pro, Pro+, and Max
summary: When a GitHub Actions job fails, Copilot Pro, Pro+, and Max subscribers can now ask Copilot cloud agent to fix it in one click.[^c-72f7fa2450] Click the Fix with Copilot button on the workflow run logs page, and Copilot will investigate the failure, push a fix to your branch, and tag you for review when it’s done.[^c-63dce686d3]
